entity.summary: Brazil-based centralized digital-asset exchange founded in 2013, providing real-denominated cryptocurrency markets and related investment services. Following the November 2, 2026 wallet security incident, it began a phased restoration of services; Brazilian real Pix transfers returned on November 17 while crypto trading and transfers remained suspended.
entity.notes: Official company history identifies 2013 as the start of Mercado Bitcoin. November 2026 incident disclosures and subsequent reporting establish a partial restoration, not normal operations. Hypernative estimates approximately USD 49 million in affected assets; this is not a final net loss. The exchange pledged to replace affected assets with its own funds; completion of restitution has not been independently established. Full crypto service restoration remains unconfirmed.

expected.summary: Brazil-based centralized exchange launched in 2013 and still operating under the Mercado Bitcoin brand.

events.title: Mercado Bitcoin began operating in 2013
events.description: Mercado Bitcoin began operating in Brazil in 2013 as a cryptocurrency trading platform.
events.notes: Year-level launch marker based on official company history.

events.title: Mercado Bitcoin received a US$200 million SoftBank investment
events.description: Mercado Bitcoin's parent group received a US$200 million investment from SoftBank's Latin America Fund, making the business a Brazilian crypto-sector unicorn and funding regional expansion.
events.notes: The financing expanded the Mercado Bitcoin group and did not change the exchange's active status.

events.title: Mercado Bitcoin wallet security incident
events.description: Mercado Bitcoin reported a security incident in one of its systems on November 2. Hypernative subsequently estimated approximately USD 49 million in affected assets; Bitquery separately estimated USD 48.6 million. These are gross outflow estimates, not established final net losses or customer losses.
events.amount_text: Approximately USD 49 million estimated gross outflow

events.title: Mercado Bitcoin temporarily suspended withdrawals
events.description: The exchange temporarily suspended withdrawals as a precaution following the November 2 security incident.

events.title: Mercado Bitcoin temporarily suspended deposits
events.description: The exchange temporarily suspended deposits following the security incident.

events.title: Mercado Bitcoin updated its asset replacement and restoration plan
events.description: In a November 4 update, Mercado Bitcoin reiterated its commitment to replace assets affected by the incident using its own resources. This was a commitment, not verification that compensation or asset recovery had been completed.

events.title: Mercado Bitcoin began read-only restoration
events.description: The exchange began its phased restoration with customer balance access. This did not establish restoration of crypto trading or withdrawals.

events.title: Mercado Bitcoin resumed Brazilian real Pix transfers
events.description: The exchange began restoring Brazilian real deposits and withdrawals via Pix, with account revalidation and security restrictions. Cryptoasset trading and transfers remained suspended at the time of reporting; full restoration was not established.
